decisionsTitle: Member tiers: the club names its levels, each member holds one, the zone and the members' page show it, a partner's code may be for some levels only
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-18 01:25, of the members' zone:** «Also for the member zone I want member Tiers.» Nothing more was said; the design below is the dispatcher's and stays open to his word.

**Decision.** The club names its membership levels, gives each member one, and the members' zone, the public members' page and the partners' codes read it. **A tier is a label and what the member gets, never a permission** (the owner, 2026-10-10: grants are per person — `shop.manage` — not by a role or a level): no door, no verb and no role reads a tier. `canManageMemberTiers` (the Administrator and the Superadministrator, §450) is who names them; `canHoldMemberTier` (a club member's account, never a colleague's) is who can hold one — both about the kind of account, neither about the level. The membership tests (`tests/integration/cms/member-tiers.test.ts`) hold that a member with a level and one without pass every door the same.

- **The data (migration 0169, expand only).** `member_tiers` (a name in each language up to 40 characters, a description in each up to 400, both languages or neither for the description, a `glyph` from a closed set of twelve with `star` as the default, `position` from 1, `hidden`, who last wrote it); `staff_users.member_tier_id` (nullable, `ON DELETE SET NULL` as the net, the service being the guard); `member_discount_codes.tier_ids uuid[]` (null or empty is every member). **An array, not a join table:** a club has a handful of levels (at most twelve, `MEMBER_TIERS_MAX`), the read is one `= any()` and the delete's guard is one count; a join table would give a foreign key the guard needs anyway, since an empty limit means *every member* — deleting the only level a code names must not open the code to everyone.
- **«Niveluri de membru» on «Pagini» → «Membri».** A named card (the house's `Panel`) with ONE form and ONE «Salvează toate nivelurile» (§791's roles editor is the model): a row per level — its name and description as one Română | English strip (§572) with «Tradu din română» under the English boxes and «Tradu cardul: RO → EN» in the header (§464, §514), the symbol from a select that draws each glyph (`GlyphSelect`), «Poziția», the tick «Ascuns» — and the blank row at the end that adds a level. The order is the numbers typed, by §791's rule (a lower number goes before the level that holds it, a higher one after it, a new level with no number last), rewritten 1 … n at the save; a level that only gave way is rewritten silently. The first refused row refuses the whole save, naming its boxes, and nothing is written. «Șterge nivelul» is its own confirmed action: refused while a member holds the level (`MEMBER_TIER_HAS_MEMBERS`, with how many) and while a code is for that level alone (`MEMBER_TIER_IN_CODES`); a code shared with other levels loses the id in the same transaction and its version moves on. The Administrator's; the Organizer and the Redactor read the list and the counts.
- **A member's level on «Echipa».** A select «Nivel» on every `MEMBER` row (the levels not hidden, «—» for none, and the hidden one the member holds, marked), saved with its own button that asks first; on «Adaugă mai mulți membri» one select for all the rows the press adds (an address that was already a member keeps the level it has: pressing again to retry an account must not change anybody's level). A colleague's row has no select and holds no level; a role change away from `MEMBER` clears it in the same transaction. A member with no level is simply «Membru». Audited by ids and the shape of the change (`staff.member_tier.set` / `.cleared`, `member_tier.added` / `.edited` / `.moved` / `.deleted`) — never a name, a description or an address.
- **Hidden** is *no longer given and not advertised*: a hidden level is not offered in the selects (except on the row of the member who holds it), is not on the public page, and members who hold it keep it — the badge and the codes. It takes nothing away from anyone.
- **Where it shows.** The members' zone, under the member's name: a badge — the level's glyph and name on `GlyphChip` (the glyph travels as a name, `tier:<name>` in the public table) and the description behind the «?» (`QuietHelp`). The public members' page, after «Beneficiile membrilor» and before the door: «Nivelurile de membru», the visible levels in the club's order with their descriptions, only when at least one exists, through the public cache (`cachedMemberTiers`, kind `pages`, expired by every save and delete). The zone's «Coduri de reducere» tab: a member sees the codes for everyone and those of their level, a member with no level the first alone, and each limited code wears one small chip per level it names.
- **The codes' limit.** In the codes' editor each code gets the chips «Pentru nivelurile» — a pill per level with the native tick visible (`CHOICE_CARD_SX`, the volunteers' role chips' surface), none ticked meaning every member, said under the chips. Adding and the limit are the Administrator's (§552 amended: a Redactor still writes the partner and the two descriptions alone, the limit kept as stored). Each code's line says «Pentru toți membrii» or «Pentru: …».
- **The shop is untouched.** A tier price or a tier-only product is a later ask.

**Refused:** a tier as a role or a permission, or any door that reads it; a join table (above); a colleague holding a level; deleting a level while a member holds it or a code is for it alone; a level on the registration form, the bib, a members' event or the shop (§796, §664 and §683 are untouched); a page of its own for the levels; one save per level (§791's reason). **Amends** §524 (the zone names the member's level), §517 and §552 (a code may be for some levels only), and reuses §791's editor shape.

**Decided in code, the owner may reverse it:** a colleague who is not a member (an Administrator previewing the zone, a volunteer) holds no level, so the zone reads every code for such an account — decided by the kind of account (`canHoldMemberTier`), never by a level — and the chips still say which codes are limited; before the levels existed every zone visitor saw every code, and a colleague must still be able to check what a member of a level sees. A hidden level is not named in a chip to a member who does not hold it. **Open for the owner:** (1) twelve levels at most; (2) whether a level should ever carry a price or a product of its own (the shop, a later ask); (3) whether the notice's new clause (the level the club gives a member) should wait behind a `{{memberTiers}}` marker and an `/admin/tasks` row until the lawyer has read it, as the volunteers' did.
changelogLine: - **Member tiers («Niveluri de membru»)** — the club names its membership levels in «Pagini» → «Membri» (a name and a description in both languages, a symbol, an order, hidden or not, one «Salvează toate nivelurile»), gives each member one on «Echipa» (or one for all the members it adds), the zone shows the member's level under their name, the public members' page lists the levels, and a partner's discount code may be for some levels only; a level is a label and what the member gets, never a permission. Migration 0169. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Pagini» → «Membri», when the Administrator opens «Niveluri de membru», then it is one form with one «Salvează toate nivelurile», a row per level (its name and description in Română | English tabs, a symbol from a closed set of twelve, «Poziția», «Ascuns») and a blank row that adds one, «Șterge nivelul» asks first and is refused while a member holds the level, and the public members' page lists the visible levels after «Beneficiile membrilor» (2026-10-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The member tiers are named, saved in one transaction, ordered, hidden and deleted by an Administrator or a Superadministrator only — a Redactor, a volunteer and a member are refused every write; the first refused row refuses the whole save and writes nothing; a level is refused deletion while a member holds it or a code is for it alone; and no function that decides what a person may do reads a member's level (2026-10-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A member's level is given, changed or cleared on the member's row of «Echipa» by an Administrator only, to a `MEMBER` account only and never a hidden level to a member who does not hold it; «Adaugă mai mulți membri» gives one level to the rows it adds and leaves an existing member's alone; a role change away from `MEMBER` clears it; every change is audited by ids, never a name or an address (2026-10-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A discount code ticked for some member levels is shown in the members' zone to a member who holds one of them and to nobody else, with one chip per level it names; a code with no level ticked is shown to every member, and a member with no level sees only those; a Redactor's save keeps the limit as stored, and deleting a level takes its id off the codes it shares (2026-10-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a member who holds a level, when the member opens the members' zone, then the zone shows the level's symbol and name under the greeting with its description behind a «?», nothing when the member holds none, and at 320 px the badge and its «?» stay inside the page without scrolling sideways; an account that cannot hold a level (a colleague) sees every code in the zone, a member only the codes for everyone and for their level (2026-10-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
